jobs.title: Senior Platform Designer
jobs.description:
Are you a senior designer who wants to shape how a complex clinical platform evolves across genomics, oncology, imaging, and real-world data? Join our Platform Design & Innovation team to own cross-cutting design problems across SOPHiA DDM™: a multimodal platform serving geneticists, pathologists, oncologists, bioinformaticians, and pharma researchers in one of the most consequential domains in healthcare.
 You'll design for expert users operating under clinical pressure, not for consumer simplicity, and your work will directly influence what gets built across variant interpretation, oncology decision support, radiomics, and research data access. This is a role where design changes outcomes, and where the complexity is the point.
 If you are a designer who earns trust with engineers and PMs from your credible technical background, moves fast from research to prototype to validation, and wants a clear path toward leading a design function — join the SOPHiA GENETICS Platform Design & Innovation team as our new Senior Platform Designer, and help us make a positive impact on the outcomes for cancer and rare disease patients worldwide. This is a senior individual contributor role with a clear path to team leadership.

Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule allowing 2 days PW home working, collaborating closely with colleagues in our Rolle, CH or Bidart, FR corporate office.
 Our Mission
 We believe there is a smarter, more data-driven way to make decisions in healthcare and our cloud-native AI powered SOPHiA DDM Platform makes that vision a reality on a daily basis. You will have direct input to our mission to democratize data-driven medicine for the ultimate benefit of cancer and rare disease patients across the globe.
 Your Mission
 As our Senior Platform Product Designer, you will combine genuine product design depth with rapid prototyping capability and the product judgment to drive design decisions from user research through to shipped features.
 The Platform Design & Innovation (PDI) is the team responsible for how DDM evolves as a platform: cross-cutting design patterns, the design system, high-value product initiatives, and the translation of complex clinical requirements into coherent product experiences across all application teams.
 This is not a role for someone whose strength is visual polish. It is a role for a designer who thinks in workflows and mental models, who holds product judgment conversations with engineering and PM, and who produces work that changes what gets built.
 The value you bring:
 Work at expert-user depth - across diverse user groups

• Conduct research with users across the platform’s range: genomics experts operating at high information density (geneticists, pathologists, bioinformaticians), oncologists and clinicians using Carepath for treatment decision support, and pharma researchers accessing real-world data through DataHub. These are not the same user; designing well for each without fragmenting the platform is the hard problem.

• Design for appropriate complexity, not for consumer simplicity. Expert users read variant tables and imaging reports under clinical pressure; pharma researchers need research-grade data access with audit controls; oncologists need actionable summaries without losing access to underlying evidence. Your designs must match the cognitive model of whoever is in front of the screen.

• Balance clinical workflow fidelity with IVD regulatory constraints: traceability, audit trail, accessibility, and the interaction patterns that survive regulatory review.
 Own cross-platform design problems

• Lead the design of major DDM platform workflows across the full product surface: variant triage and interpretation in the genomics platform, oncology decision-support workflows in Carepath, multimodal data views that combine genomic and imaging signals, and DataHub experiences for clinical and pharma research users.

• Define and evolve the cross-surface interaction patterns that give the platform coherence: how data from different modalities is presented together, how classification decisions are recorded and traced, how clinical and research users with different expertise levels navigate the same underlying data.

• Govern and evolve the DDM design system in collaboration with engineering: component usage, token standards, interaction primitives, and the documentation that makes the system usable across teams.
 Prototype and validate

• Build interactive prototypes to compress the time between concept and clinical feedback. Use whatever tooling compresses that cycle, (AI-assisted code, low-code scaffolding, or hand-crafted HTML) with the goal of getting something real in front of users quickly.

• Run validation sessions with clinical users, oncologists, and pharma partners early and continuously. Treat user research as a design input, not a sign-off step.
 Partner with engineering, product, and cross-team stakeholders

• Work alongside platform engineering as a peer. Translate between the language of design (workflows, mental models, jobs-to-be-done) and the language of engineering (APIs, data models, performance, security). The role succeeds when both teams move faster because of how well you operate at that boundary.

• Collaborate with Product Owners and Product Managers across application teams — HemOnc, Solid Tumor & LBx, RID, Carepath, DataHub. PDI’s mandate is transversal: you do not sit within one team’s scope, you influence platform-level decisions across all of them. That requires earning trust with POs and PMs who have their own roadmaps and priorities, and shaping shared vision without direct authority.
 Grow towards team leadership

• Build influence across engineering, product, data science, clinical stakeholders, and executive leadership. Raise the quality bar for design artifacts across teams. Develop readiness for team leadership: mentoring junior designers, shaping team process, and taking ownership of a design function.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un senior designer che vuole modellare come una complessa piattaforma clinica si evolve attraverso genomica, oncologia, imaging e dati reali? Unisciti al nostro team di Platform Design & Innovation per avere problemi di progettazione cross-cutting in SOPHiA DDMTM: una piattaforma multimodale che serve genetica, patologi, oncologi, bioinformatici e ricercatori farmaceutici in uno dei domini più conseguenti della sanità.
Potrai progettare per gli utenti esperti che operano sotto pressione clinica, non per la semplicità del consumatore, e il tuo lavoro influenzerà direttamente ciò che viene costruito attraverso l'interpretazione variante, il supporto decisionale oncology, radiomics e l'accesso ai dati di ricerca. Questo è un ruolo in cui il design cambia i risultati, e dove la complessità è il punto.
Se sei un designer che guadagna fiducia con gli ingegneri e i PM dal tuo credibile background tecnico, si muove velocemente dalla ricerca al prototipo alla validazione, e vuole un percorso chiaro verso la guida di una funzione di progettazione - unire il team di progettazione e innovazione della piattaforma SOPHiA GENETICS come il nostro nuovo Senior Platform Designer, e ci aiutano a fare un impatto positivo sui risultati per il cancro e pazienti con malattie rare in tutto il mondo. Questo è un ruolo di contribuente individuale senior con un percorso chiaro per la leadership di squadra.

Godetevi la flessibilità di un programma di lavoro ibrido che consente 2 giorni di lavoro a casa PW, collaborando a stretto contatto con i colleghi del nostro ufficio aziendale Rolle, CH o Bidart, FR.
La nostra missione
Crediamo che ci sia un modo più intelligente e più orientato ai dati per prendere decisioni nel settore sanitario e la nostra piattaforma DDM alimentata da AI cloud SOPHiA rende questa visione una realtà quotidiana. Avrete un input diretto alla nostra missione di democratizzare la medicina basata sui dati per il beneficio finale del cancro e dei pazienti affetti da malattie rare in tutto il mondo.
La tua missione
Come il nostro Senior Platform Product Designer, si unirà genuina profondità di progettazione del prodotto con capacità di prototipazione rapida e il giudizio del prodotto per guidare le decisioni di progettazione dalla ricerca degli utenti attraverso le caratteristiche spedite.
Il Platform Design & Innovation (PDI) è il team responsabile di come DDM si evolve come piattaforma: modelli di progettazione cross-cutting, sistema di progettazione, iniziative di prodotto ad alto valore, e la traduzione di complessi requisiti clinici in esperienze di prodotto coerenti in tutti i team di applicazione.
Questo non è un ruolo per qualcuno la cui forza è lucida visiva. È un ruolo per un designer che pensa ai flussi di lavoro e ai modelli mentali, che tiene le conversazioni di giudizio di prodotto con l'ingegneria e PM, e che produce lavoro che cambia ciò che viene costruito.
Il valore che porti:
Lavorare alla profondità dell'utente esperto - attraverso diversi gruppi di utenti

• Condurre la ricerca con gli utenti attraverso la gamma della piattaforma: esperti genomici che operano ad alta densità di informazioni (genetici, patologi, bioinformatica), oncologi e clinici che utilizzano Carepath per il supporto delle decisioni di trattamento, e ricercatori di farmaci che accedono ai dati del mondo reale attraverso DataHub. Questi non sono lo stesso utente; progettare bene per ciascuno senza frammentare la piattaforma è il problema difficile.

• Design per un'adeguata complessità, non per la semplicità dei consumatori. Gli utenti esperti leggono tabelle di variante e rapporti di imaging sotto pressione clinica; i ricercatori di farmaci hanno bisogno di accesso ai dati di livello di ricerca con i controlli di audit; gli oncologi hanno bisogno di sintesi attuabili senza perdere l'accesso alle prove sottostanti. I vostri disegni devono corrispondere al modello cognitivo di chiunque sia davanti allo schermo.

• Fidelizzazione del flusso di lavoro clinico di equilibrio con vincoli normativi IVD: tracciabilità, percorso di audit, accessibilità e i modelli di interazione che sopravvivono alla revisione normativa.
Problemi di progettazione cross-platform

• Guidare la progettazione dei principali flussi di lavoro della piattaforma DDM attraverso la superficie completa del prodotto: triage variante e interpretazione nella piattaforma genomica, flussi di lavoro di supporto decisionale oncologia in Carepath, visualizzazioni multimodali dei dati che combinano i segnali genomici e di imaging, e le esperienze di DataHub per gli utenti di ricerca clinica e farmaceutica.

• Definire ed evolvere i modelli di interazione cross-surface che danno la coerenza della piattaforma: come i dati provenienti da diverse modalità vengono presentati insieme, come le decisioni di classificazione vengono registrate e tracciate, come gli utenti clinici e di ricerca con diversi livelli di esperienza navigano gli stessi dati sottostanti.

• Governare ed evolvere il sistema di progettazione DDM in collaborazione con l'ingegneria: utilizzo dei componenti, standard di token, primitivi di interazione, e la documentazione che rende il sistema utilizzabile in team.
Prototipo e convalida

• Costruire prototipi interattivi per comprimere il tempo tra concetto e feedback clinico. Utilizzare qualsiasi strumento comprime quel ciclo, (codice AI-assisted, ponteggio a basso codice, o HTML artigianale) con l'obiettivo di ottenere qualcosa di reale davanti agli utenti rapidamente.

• Eseguire sessioni di validazione con utenti clinici, oncologi e partner farmaceutici in anticipo e in continuo. Tratta la ricerca degli utenti come input di progettazione, non un passaggio di segnale.
Partner con parti interessate di ingegneria, prodotto e cross-team

• Lavorare insieme l'ingegneria della piattaforma come pari. Traduci tra il linguaggio del design (flussi di lavoro, modelli mentali, lavori da fare) e il linguaggio dell'ingegneria (API, modelli di dati, prestazioni, sicurezza). Il ruolo riesce quando entrambe le squadre si muovono più velocemente a causa di quanto bene si opera a quel confine.

• Collabora con Product Owners e Product Manager in team di applicazioni – HemOnc, Solid Tumor & LBx, RID, Carepath, DataHub. Il mandato di PDI è trasversale: non ti siedi nell’ambito di una squadra, si influenzano le decisioni a livello di piattaforma su tutti loro. Ciò richiede guadagnare fiducia con PO e PM che hanno le proprie roadmap e priorità, e plasmare la visione condivisa senza autorità diretta.
Crescere verso la leadership di squadra

• Costruire l'influenza tra ingegneria, prodotto, scienza dei dati, stakeholder clinici e leadership esecutiva. Alzare la barra di qualità per artefatti di design attraverso le squadre. Sviluppare la disponibilità per la leadership di squadra: mentoring junior designer, modellare il processo di squadra, e prendere la proprietà di una funzione di progettazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie ein Senior Designer, der gestalten möchte, wie sich eine komplexe klinische Plattform über Genomik, Onkologie, Bildgebung und reale Daten entwickelt? Schließen Sie sich unserem Platform Design & Innovation-Team an, um übergreifende Designprobleme in SOPHiA DDMTM zu besitzen: eine multimodale Plattform, die Genetikern, Pathologen, Onkologen, Bioinformatikern und Pharmaforschern in einem der folgenreichsten Bereiche des Gesundheitswesens dient.
Sie entwerfen für erfahrene Benutzer, die unter klinischem Druck arbeiten, nicht für die Einfachheit der Verbraucher, und Ihre Arbeit wird direkt beeinflussen, was über Varianteninterpretation, onkologische Entscheidungsunterstützung, Radiomiken und Forschungsdatenzugriff aufgebaut wird. Dies ist eine Rolle, bei der das Design die Ergebnisse verändert und wo die Komplexität der Punkt ist.
Wenn Sie ein Designer sind, der Vertrauen zu Ingenieuren und PMs aus Ihrem glaubwürdigen technischen Hintergrund verdient, sich schnell von der Forschung über den Prototyp bis zur Validierung bewegt und einen klaren Weg zur Leitung einer Designfunktion wünscht - treten Sie dem SOPHiA GENETICS Platform Design & Innovation-Team als unser neuer Senior Platform Designer bei und helfen Sie uns, die Ergebnisse für Krebs- und seltene Krankheiten weltweit positiv zu beeinflussen. Dies ist eine leitende Einzelbeitragsrolle mit einem klaren Weg zur Teamführung.

Genießen Sie die Flexibilität eines hybriden Arbeitsplans, der 2 Tage PW zu Hause arbeiten lässt und eng mit Kollegen in unserem Büro in Rolle, CH oder Bidart, FR zusammenarbeitet.
Unsere Mission
Wir glauben, dass es einen intelligenteren, datengestützten Weg gibt, um Entscheidungen im Gesundheitswesen zu treffen, und unsere Cloud-native KI-basierte SOPHiA DDM-Plattform macht diese Vision täglich Realität. Sie werden direkten Input zu unserer Mission haben, datengesteuerte Medizin für den ultimativen Nutzen von Krebs und Patienten mit seltenen Krankheiten auf der ganzen Welt zu demokratisieren.
Deine Mission
Als Senior Platform Product Designer kombinieren Sie echte Produktdesigntiefe mit Rapid Prototyping-Fähigkeit und dem Produkturteil, um Designentscheidungen von der Benutzerforschung bis hin zu ausgelieferten Funktionen zu treffen.
Das Platform Design & Innovation (PDI) ist das Team, das dafür verantwortlich ist, wie sich DDM als Plattform entwickelt: übergreifende Designmuster, das Designsystem, hochwertige Produktinitiativen und die Übersetzung komplexer klinischer Anforderungen in kohärente Produkterfahrungen in allen Anwendungsteams.
Dies ist keine Rolle für jemanden, dessen Stärke visuell polnisch ist. Es ist eine Rolle für einen Designer, der in Workflows und mentalen Modellen denkt, der Produkturteilsgespräche mit Engineering und PM führt und Arbeit produziert, die verändert, was gebaut wird.
Der Wert, den Sie bringen:
Arbeiten mit Experten-Benutzer-Tiefe - über verschiedene Benutzergruppen hinweg

• Führen Sie Forschung mit Benutzern im gesamten Spektrum der Plattform durch: Genomikexperten mit hoher Informationsdichte (Genetiker, Pathologen, Bioinformatiker), Onkologen und Kliniker, die Carepath für die Entscheidungsunterstützung bei der Behandlung nutzen, und Pharmaforscher, die über DataHub auf reale Daten zugreifen. Dies sind nicht die gleichen Benutzer; Design gut für jeden ohne Fragmentierung der Plattform ist das schwierige Problem.

• Design für angemessene Komplexität, nicht für die Einfachheit des Verbrauchers. Fachkundige Benutzer lesen Variantentabellen und Bildgebungsberichte unter klinischem Druck; Pharmaforscher benötigen Datenzugriff auf Forschungsniveau mit Auditkontrollen; Onkologen benötigen umsetzbare Zusammenfassungen, ohne den Zugang zu den zugrunde liegenden Beweisen zu verlieren. Ihre Designs müssen dem kognitiven Modell desjenigen entsprechen, der sich vor dem Bildschirm befindet.

• Balance klinische Workflow Treue mit IVD regulatorischen Einschränkungen: Rückverfolgbarkeit, Audit-Trail, Zugänglichkeit und die Interaktionsmuster, die regulatorische Überprüfung überleben.
Eigene Cross-Plattform-Design-Probleme

• Führen Sie das Design der wichtigsten DDM-Plattform-Workflows über die gesamte Produktoberfläche: Varianten-Triage und Interpretation in der Genomik-Plattform, onkologische Entscheidungsunterstützungs-Workflows in Carepath, multimodale Datenansichten, die genomische und bildgebende Signale kombinieren, und DataHub-Erfahrungen für klinische und pharmazeutische Forschungsnutzer.

• Definieren und entwickeln Sie die oberflächenübergreifenden Interaktionsmuster, die der Plattform Kohärenz verleihen: wie Daten aus verschiedenen Modalitäten zusammen präsentiert werden, wie Klassifizierungsentscheidungen aufgezeichnet und verfolgt werden, wie klinische und Forschungsbenutzer mit unterschiedlichem Fachwissen durch die gleichen zugrunde liegenden Daten navigieren.

• Leiten und entwickeln Sie das DDM-Designsystem in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Engineering: Komponentennutzung, Token-Standards, Interaktionsprimitiven und die Dokumentation, die das System teamübergreifend nutzbar macht.
Prototyp und validieren

• Erstellen Sie interaktive Prototypen, um die Zeit zwischen Konzept und klinischem Feedback zu komprimieren. Verwenden Sie alle Werkzeuge, die diesen Zyklus komprimieren (KI-unterstützter Code, Low-Code-Gerüst oder handgefertigtes HTML), um den Benutzern schnell etwas Echtes zu zeigen.

• Führen Sie Validierungssitzungen mit klinischen Anwendern, Onkologen und Pharmapartnern frühzeitig und kontinuierlich durch. Behandeln Sie Benutzerforschung als Design-Input, nicht als Abmeldeschritt.
Partner mit Engineering-, Produkt- und Team-übergreifenden Stakeholdern

• Arbeiten neben Platform Engineering als Peer. Übersetzen Sie zwischen der Sprache des Designs (Workflows, mentale Modelle, Jobs-to-be-done) und der Sprache des Ingenieurs (APIs, Datenmodelle, Leistung, Sicherheit). Die Rolle ist erfolgreich, wenn sich beide Teams schneller bewegen, weil Sie an dieser Grenze gut arbeiten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Product Ownern und Produktmanagern in allen Anwendungsteams zusammen - HemOnc, Solid Tumor & LBx, RID, Carepath, DataHub. Das Mandat von PDI ist transversal: Sie sitzen nicht im Rahmen eines Teams, sondern beeinflussen Entscheidungen auf Plattformebene über alle hinweg. Dies erfordert Vertrauen in POs und PMs, die ihre eigenen Roadmaps und Prioritäten haben, und die Gestaltung einer gemeinsamen Vision ohne direkte Autorität.
Wachsen in Richtung Teamführung

• Aufbau von Einfluss auf Engineering, Produkt, Data Science, klinische Stakeholder und Führungskräfte. Heben Sie die Qualitätsleiste für Design-Artefakte in allen Teams an. Entwickeln Sie die Bereitschaft zur Teamführung: Mentoring für Nachwuchsdesigner, Gestaltung des Teamprozesses und Übernahme einer Designfunktion.

Êtes-vous un concepteur senior qui veut façonner comment une plate-forme clinique complexe évolue à travers la génomique, l'oncologie, l'imagerie et les données du monde réel? Rejoignez notre équipe de conception et d'innovation pour gérer des problèmes de conception transversaux dans le cadre de SOPHiA DDMTM : une plateforme multimodale au service des généticiens, pathologistes, oncologues, bioinformaticiens et chercheurs en pharmacologie dans l'un des domaines les plus significatifs en santé.
Vous concevrez pour des utilisateurs experts fonctionnant sous pression clinique, pas pour la simplicité du consommateur, et votre travail influencera directement ce qui se construit à travers l'interprétation de variantes, le support de décision oncologique, radiomique, et l'accès aux données de recherche. Il s'agit d'un rôle où la conception change les résultats et où la complexité est le point.
Si vous êtes un concepteur qui gagne la confiance avec les ingénieurs et les PM de votre expérience technique crédible, passe rapidement de la recherche au prototype à la validation, et veut une voie claire vers la conduite d'une fonction de conception — rejoignez l'équipe de conception et d'innovation de plate-forme SOPHiA GENETICS en tant que notre nouveau concepteur de plate-forme senior, et nous aider à faire un impact positif sur les résultats pour les patients atteints de cancer et de maladies rares dans le monde entier. Il s'agit d'un rôle de premier plan qui contribue à la direction de l'équipe.

Profitez de la flexibilité d'un horaire de travail hybride permettant 2 jours de travail à domicile PW, en collaboration étroite avec nos collègues de notre bureau d'entreprise Rolle, CH ou Bidart, FR.
Notre mission
Nous croyons qu'il existe une façon plus intelligente et plus axée sur les données de prendre des décisions dans le domaine des soins de santé, et notre plate-forme SOPHiA DDM, alimentée par le cloud, fait de cette vision une réalité quotidienne. Vous aurez une contribution directe à notre mission de démocratisation de la médecine axée sur les données pour le bénéfice ultime des patients atteints de cancer et de maladies rares dans le monde entier.
Votre mission
En tant que Senior Platform Product Designer, vous combinerez une véritable profondeur de conception de produit avec une capacité de prototypage rapide et le jugement produit pour conduire les décisions de conception de la recherche utilisateur à des fonctionnalités expédiées.
La plate-forme Design & Innovation (PDI) est l'équipe responsable de l'évolution du DDM en tant que plate-forme : modèles de conception transversaux, système de conception, initiatives de produits de grande valeur et traduction d'exigences cliniques complexes en expériences de produits cohérentes dans toutes les équipes d'application.
Ce n'est pas un rôle pour quelqu'un dont la force est le vernis visuel. C'est un rôle pour un concepteur qui pense dans les workflows et les modèles mentaux, qui tient des conversations de jugement produit avec l'ingénierie et le PM, et qui produit du travail qui change ce qui se construit.
La valeur que vous apportez :
Travail à la profondeur expert-utilisateur - à travers divers groupes d'utilisateurs

• Mener des recherches avec les utilisateurs de toute la plate-forme : experts en génomique opérant à haute densité d'information (génétiques, pathologistes, bioinformaticiens), oncologues et cliniciens utilisant Carepath pour l'aide à la décision de traitement, et chercheurs en pharmacologie ayant accès aux données du monde réel via DataHub. Ce ne sont pas les mêmes utilisateurs; concevoir bien pour chacun sans fragmenter la plateforme est le problème difficile.

• Conception pour une complexité appropriée, pas pour la simplicité du consommateur. Les utilisateurs experts lisent des tableaux de variantes et des rapports d'imagerie sous pression clinique; les chercheurs en pharmacologie ont besoin d'un accès aux données de niveau de recherche avec des contrôles de vérification; les oncologues ont besoin de résumés exploitables sans perdre l'accès aux preuves sous-jacentes. Vos dessins doivent correspondre au modèle cognitif de celui qui est devant l'écran.

• Équilibrer la fidélité des processus cliniques avec les contraintes réglementaires de la DIV : traçabilité, piste de vérification, accessibilité et modèles d'interaction qui survivent à l'examen réglementaire.
Problèmes de conception des plates-formes croisées

• Diriger la conception des principaux flux de travail de la plate-forme DDM sur toute la surface du produit : tri des variantes et interprétation dans la plate-forme génomique, flux de travail d'appui à la décision en oncologie dans Carepath, vues de données multimodales qui combinent signaux génomiques et d'imagerie, et expériences DataHub pour les utilisateurs de la recherche clinique et pharmaceutique.

• Définir et développer les modèles d'interactions entre les surfaces qui assurent la cohérence de la plate-forme: comment les données provenant de différentes modalités sont présentées ensemble, comment les décisions de classification sont enregistrées et tracées, comment les utilisateurs cliniques et de la recherche ayant différents niveaux d'expertise naviguent sur les mêmes données sous-jacentes.

• Construire des prototypes interactifs pour compresser le temps entre le concept et la rétroaction clinique. Utilisez n'importe quel outil compresse ce cycle, (code assisté par l'AI, échafaudage de code bas ou HTML fabriqué à la main) dans le but d'obtenir quelque chose de réel devant les utilisateurs rapidement.

• Exécuter des séances de validation avec les utilisateurs cliniques, les oncologues et les partenaires pharmaceutiques tôt et continuellement. Traiter la recherche des utilisateurs comme une entrée de conception, et non comme une étape d'approbation.
Partenaire avec les intervenants de l'ingénierie, des produits et des équipes transversales

• Travaillez avec l'ingénierie de plateforme en tant que pair. Traduire entre le langage du design (flux de travail, modèles mentaux, emplois à faire) et le langage de l'ingénierie (API, modèles de données, performance, sécurité). Le rôle réussit lorsque les deux équipes se déplacent plus rapidement en raison de la façon dont vous travaillez à cette limite.

• Collaborer avec les propriétaires de produits et les gestionnaires de produits entre les équipes d'application — HemOnc, Solid Tumor & LBx, RID, Carepath, DataHub. Le mandat du PDI est transversal : vous n'êtes pas dans le cadre d'une seule équipe, vous influencez les décisions au niveau de la plate-forme sur toutes ces questions. Pour cela, il faut gagner de la confiance auprès des OP et des PM qui ont leurs propres feuilles de route et priorités, et façonner une vision partagée sans autorité directe.
Vers une direction d'équipe

• Accroître l'influence de l'ingénierie, des produits, de la science des données, des intervenants cliniques et du leadership exécutif. Relever la barre de qualité pour concevoir des artefacts à travers les équipes. Développer la préparation à la direction de l'équipe : mentorer les concepteurs juniors, façonner le processus d'équipe et s'approprier une fonction de conception.

jobs.description:
Description
 Do you have experience in Quality Assurances with NCs and CAPA? Are you available for a contract opportunity imminently? If this sounds like you and you are driven by purpose, join the SOPHiA GENETICS Quality Team as a Quality Associate, and enable us to make a positive impact on the outcomes for cancer and rare disease patients worldwide.

This is a contract opportunity until 31/05/2027 . This is a hybrid role, and you can expect to be in our office in Rolle at least 3 days per week.

Our Mission
 We believe there is a smarter, more data-driven way to make decisions in healthcare and our cloud-native AI powered SOPHiA DDM Platform makes that vision a reality on a daily basis. You will have direct input to our mission to democratize data-driven medicine for the ultimate benefit of cancer and rare disease patients across the globe.

Your Mission
 As part of our Quality team, this role supports the team during periods of absence and an increased workload, taking ownership of Non-Conformity (NC) management, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and the Change Control Process (CCP).

The value you bring:

• Conduct ongoing reviews of open and historical NCs to close gaps and ensure we're audit-ready ahead of our next inspection

• Manage CAPAs end-to-end — from root cause analysis through implementation and effectiveness verification

• Support Change Control Process (CCP) activities, ensuring changes are properly assessed, documented, and approved before implementation

• Partner with cross-functional teams — Supply Chain, Procurement, Data Science, and IT — to gather evidence, document conformity, and close out actions on time

• Identify emerging non-conformities proactively, assessing risk and recommending appropriate remediation

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready records in Veeva and Jira throughout quality processes

Have you managed on-site operational teams through shifting priorities while keeping quality, capacity, efficiency, and cost front of mind?
 If this sounds like you and you are driven by purpose, join the SOPHiA GENETICS Production team as a Manager, Production and enable us to make a positive impact on the outcomes for cancer and rare disease patients worldwide.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced IVD professional specializing in NGS-based IVD and CDx products? Ready to take on impactful new projects at the forefront of precision medicine?
 If this sounds like you and you are driven by purpose, join the SOPHiA GENETICS Bioinformatic Product Development team as our IVD Development & Validation Lead , and enable us to make a positive impact on the outcomes for cancer and rare disease patients worldwide.
 This role is a hybrid opportunity, requiring 3 days onsite our corporate office in Rolle, CH.

Our Mission
 We believe there is a smarter, more data-driven way to make decisions in healthcare and our cloud-native AI powered SOPHiA DDM Platform makes that vision a reality on a daily basis. SOPHiA GENETICS is the creator of SOPHiA DDM™, a cloud-based platform for analyzing complex multimodal data and generating insights that help healthcare institutions make faster, better informed decisions. We work primarily in oncology and inherited disorders, where integrating genomic and phenotypic data is critical for clinical decision-making, research, and drug development.
 Our data-sharing methodology connects researchers and clinicians globally, supporting a community-driven approach to precision medicine. Our mission is to democratize data-driven medicine and ensure that every patient has access to the best possible diagnosis.

Your Mission
 SOPHiA GENETICS has a strong NGS platform, established pharma partnerships, and a track record of delivering CE-IVD certified products. We are now scaling our CDx and CTA portfolio and investing in the IVD development and validation expertise to match that ambition, including under the more demanding requirements of IVDR and FDA.
 This role sits within a cross-functional organization, working closely with colleagues across bioinformatics, NGS assay development, regulatory, and clinical operations. Depending on your background, you will own the validation program for one or more CDx/CTA projects or take broader technical ownership across the full development lifecycle, from assay and bioinformatics pipeline development through V&V and the full regulatory evidence package.
 We work with urgency and purpose to meet the demands of patients and our pharma partners. This means knowing what a study needs to demonstrate, designing it accordingly, and not adding work that does not contribute to that goal. It also means building processes and standards that hold up as the portfolio grows.

The value you bring
 Validation

• Own the design and execution of validation programs for NGS-based IVD and CDx products, covering analytical performance, clinical performance, usability, and stability.

• Design studies that are fit for purpose: the right methodology, acceptance criteria, and statistical approaches based on what needs to be demonstrated and the applicable regulatory context, drawing on relevant guidance (CLSI, professional standards, etc) and your own experience.

• Handle the statistical aspects of V&V studies across the full range of study types - you know the standard approaches, when to apply them, and how to establish defensible methods. You do not need to be a dedicated biostatistician, but you need a solid command of the standard approaches.

• Produce DHF-ready documentation, written clearly enough to be reviewed without extensive back-and-forth.

• Build reusable validation frameworks, templates, and SOPs that can be applied consistently across programs
 Technical project leadership (for more senior candidates)

• Be accountable for the technical success of CDx/CTA development programs end-to-end, from assay and bioinformatics pipeline development through verification, validation, and submission-ready regulatory evidence.

• Connect the development, validation, and regulatory sub-teams, to ensure efficient project delivery and effective project risk mitigation.

• Define the regulatory evidence strategy in collaboration with the Regulatory Lead: what is required, what is sufficient, what is not needed.
 Diagnostics development processes

• Design the processes and standards that allow a growing diagnostics portfolio to be delivered consistently and efficiently across programs.

• Work closely with NGS scientists, bioinformaticians, regulatory, quality, and product colleagues across a highly cross-functional environment.

• Contribute to developing IVD capability across the organization and mentoring junior scientists where relevant.

Are you an experienced IVD professional specializing in NGS-based IVD and CDx products? Ready to take on impactful new projects at the forefront of precision medicine?
If this sounds like you and you are driven by purpose, join the SOPHiA GENETICS Bioinformatic Product Development team as our IVD Development & Validation Lead , and enable us to make a positive impact on the outcomes for cancer and rare disease patients worldwide.
This role is a hybrid opportunity, requiring 3 days onsite our corporate office in Rolle, CH.

Our Mission
We believe there is a smarter, more data-driven way to make decisions in healthcare and our cloud-native AI powered SOPHiA DDM Platform makes that vision a reality on a daily basis. SOPHiA GENETICS is the creator of SOPHiA DDM™, a cloud-based platform for analyzing complex multimodal data and generating insights that help healthcare institutions make faster, better informed decisions. We work primarily in oncology and inherited disorders, where integrating genomic and phenotypic data is critical for clinical decision-making, research, and drug development.
Our data-sharing methodology connects researchers and clinicians globally, supporting a community-driven approach to precision medicine. Our mission is to democratize data-driven medicine and ensure that every patient has access to the best possible diagnosis.

Your Mission
SOPHiA GENETICS has a strong NGS platform, established pharma partnerships, and a track record of delivering CE-IVD certified products. We are now scaling our CDx and CTA portfolio and investing in the IVD development and validation expertise to match that ambition, including under the more demanding requirements of IVDR and FDA.
This role sits within a cross-functional organization, working closely with colleagues across bioinformatics, NGS assay development, regulatory, and clinical operations. Depending on your background, you will own the validation program for one or more CDx/CTA projects or take broader technical ownership across the full development lifecycle, from assay and bioinformatics pipeline development through V&V and the full regulatory evidence package.
We work with urgency and purpose to meet the demands of patients and our pharma partners. This means knowing what a study needs to demonstrate, designing it accordingly, and not adding work that does not contribute to that goal. It also means building processes and standards that hold up as the portfolio grows.

The value you bring
Validation

• Own the design and execution of validation programs for NGS-based IVD and CDx products, covering analytical performance, clinical performance, usability, and stability.

• Design studies that are fit for purpose: the right methodology, acceptance criteria, and statistical approaches based on what needs to be demonstrated and the applicable regulatory context, drawing on relevant guidance (CLSI, professional standards, etc) and your own experience.

• Handle the statistical aspects of V&V studies across the full range of study types - you know the standard approaches, when to apply them, and how to establish defensible methods. You do not need to be a dedicated biostatistician, but you need a solid command of the standard approaches.

• Produce DHF-ready documentation, written clearly enough to be reviewed without extensive back-and-forth.

• Build reusable validation frameworks, templates, and SOPs that can be applied consistently across programs
Technical project leadership (for more senior candidates)

• Be accountable for the technical success of CDx/CTA development programs end-to-end, from assay and bioinformatics pipeline development through verification, validation, and submission-ready regulatory evidence.

• Connect the development, validation, and regulatory sub-teams, to ensure efficient project delivery and effective project risk mitigation.

• Define the regulatory evidence strategy in collaboration with the Regulatory Lead: what is required, what is sufficient, what is not needed.
Diagnostics development processes

• Design the processes and standards that allow a growing diagnostics portfolio to be delivered consistently and efficiently across programs.

• Work closely with NGS scientists, bioinformaticians, regulatory, quality, and product colleagues across a highly cross-functional environment.

• Contribute to developing IVD capability across the organization and mentoring junior scientists where relevant.
